scope: All89matched actual-pipeline cases read across original/B/C, plus all14fixed-reference pairs per new arm and11dev direct pairs per arm. Qualitative development review, not independent human accuracy. Final outputs did not change selected epochs.
verdict: Training complete; some useful shorter texting and specific context fixes, persistent contextual and rewrite-meaning errors. No demonstrated overall quality winner or default promotion.
